title: DMN PDF details
content:
# DMN PDF details

DMN documentation includes the Decision Requirements Diagram (DRD), Input Data, custom data types, included models, and the Decision Logic Level. Each boxed expression is rendered as a BPM Modeler graphic with numbered FEEL code below it. Line numbers are subtly separated from expressions by colour, and Context variable names are italic. A Function Definition uses the parameter list and body read from the DMN file in its own two-row table; a non-FEEL kind is shown as an initial in the header. Its textual form is `function(Parameter1, Parameter2, ...) Body`. In FEEL code, a Context is shown as an object-like structure, for example `{ rate: 0.19, grossPrice: netPrice * (1 + rate) }`. Its keys form a left text column, while its value expressions start beneath one another in a fixed right text column; wrapped expression lines retain that indentation. Its body may itself contain a nested boxed expression; the body cell then refers to it and the full structure follows as its own graphic. A Boxed List uses one row per item without a bullet column; its textual form is, for example, `[Apple, Pears]`. A Boxed Invocation shows its function-valued expression from the DMN file followed by parameter and binding-expression pairs. Only literal expressions appear as code in a parent cell; nested contexts, functions, invocations, lists, decision tables, and relations are rendered as their own tables. Long cell contents wrap inside their existing column, and tall tables continue with their header on the next page. Only a table structure that cannot fit readably in portrait begins on a new landscape page. SVG exports use the sanitized model name and export timestamp.

title: Include external DMN models
content:
# Include external DMN models

1. Save the main model.
2. Put the external `.dmn` files in the same directory.
3. Choose **Tools → DMN → Include external DMN models** and enable the required files.
4. BPM Modeler writes the DMN `import` reference and supplies the file to the current Apache KIE DMN Editor.
5. Save the main model.

Included models appear in the PDF section **Included Decision Models**. The external model remains its own file and is edited there.
